protocol.study: S9 frozen fresh-regime and direct-reference validation
protocol.warm_scope: resident input, primed methods/decoder, fresh per-call allocations, input I/O and oracle checks outside timer
protocol.cold_scope: first encode/decode call in separate fresh processes; resident input and parsed policy; no priming; process startup and input I/O excluded, no claim of cold OS/page/disk caches
protocol.confidence: paired bootstrap of ten entire sessions; file/family population uncertainty is a separate scope
protocol.size_scope: release/min standalone linked probes retain shared method parser, including policy external payload; conservative prototype accounting, not a measured production integration
protocol.portability: performance claims only for actually measured host; Linux CI correctness is not second-hardware performance
protocol.promotion: all role, decode, tiny, RSS, linked-size and correctness gates must pass; new emitter structures additionally require model proof coverage

policy-size.policy:
policy-v1 features-13 short-balanced-32768
B 2 273.5 1 2
L config:1024:1:0:trigram:16384
L best

finalists.selection: no fresh/tiny/RSS feedback; retain every frozen role and predeclared control

construction.scope: aligned keys only; intervening suffix/unaligned prefixes need not collide
